# Alice founds a group and adds Bob with the voucher he minted; they talk, and each next message
# acknowledges what its sender has read.

create alice g
join bob g
run
state bob g
----
not joined, awaiting a reply

invite alice g bob
run
members alice g
----
bob

members bob g
----
alice

send alice g hello bob
send bob g hello alice
run
show alice g
----
— a new group: adding a member's voucher code adds them
— reading the voucher
— added ~bob: they now read everything said in this group
alice ✓: hello bob
bob: hello alice

send bob g read you
run
show alice g
----
— a new group: adding a member's voucher code adds them
— reading the voucher
— added ~bob: they now read everything said in this group
alice ✓✓: hello bob
bob: hello alice
bob: read you

acked alice g
----
bob:1
